final: SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) as award_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country) as share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country != '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country ORDER BY share DESC, ma.player_id LIMIT 10
